Enum ErrorUtils.ErrorType

public enum ErrorUtils.ErrorType

Enumeration representing error severity levels. Values correspond to the Type__c picklist field on the ErrorLog__c object. Valid values: INFO, WARNING, ERROR, EXCEPTION_ERROR, FAULT.
